name: input-hotplug-fe
purpose: iter-464 input lane (docs/INPUT_GLYPHS.md): controller HOT-PLUG in the live game, driven ONLY by virtual pads - no keyboard, no focus. Run with -Gates SR_HARNESS_REAL_INPUT=1,SR_GLYPHS=auto and, alongside, `python tools/glyphs/vpad_hotplug.py --plan fe --log-glob <Out> --mark <Out>/marks.txt`: a ViGEm Xbox 360 pad is plugged at the title and presses START, the LOAD A GAME? popup comes up, a DualShock 4 is plugged and takes player 1 (PS prompts), it is unplugged (user 0 NOT CONNECTED), the Xbox pad's Guide takes player 1 back (360 prompts) and its A starts a new game. Then the KEYBOARD (the harness channel - still no focus) presses START in gameplay: the keyboard takes player 1 and the pause menu's hint bar shows keyboard prompts; B (the X key) closes it. Apart from those two keys this scenario only awaits the game's own transitions and holds the capture windows. -TimeoutSeconds 600.

steps.name: pad-connected
steps.purpose: The virtual Xbox 360 pad is hot-plugged by vpad_hotplug.py.

steps.name: pad-start
steps.purpose: START pressed on the virtual pad reaches the guest.

steps.name: new-game
steps.purpose: A on the virtual Xbox pad accepts the popup.

steps.name: kb-pause
steps.purpose: START from the keyboard: the keyboard becomes player 1 (keyboard prompts in the pause menu).
